entities.name: Sisters of Stone Death
entities.description: Gorgon usurper guildmasters of the Golgari Swarm on Ravnica, originally a quintet.

entities.name: Ludmilla
entities.description: Eldest surviving Sister, last living sister, later blinded and killed by the Azorius.

entities.name: Lexya
entities.description: Middle surviving Sister of Stone Death.

entities.name: Lydya
entities.description: Youngest surviving Sister of Stone Death.

entities.name: Svogthir
entities.description: Necromancer Golgari parun overthrown by the Sisters, later given a new body by Savra.

entities.name: Savra
entities.description: Devkarin matka who became the true new Golgari guildmaster.

entities.name: Feather
entities.description: Granted Ludmilla mercy on condition she never show her face on the surface.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: Teenager captured alongside Ludmilla by the Azorius.

entities.name: Golgari Swarm
entities.description: Ravnican guild ruled by the Sisters.

entities.name: Azorius
entities.description: Guild that captured Ludmilla and Vraska.

entities.name: Wojek
entities.description: Guards who deflected the Golgari attack on Centerfort.

entities.name: Centerfort
entities.description: Location attacked by Golgari during the Decamillennial.

entities.name: Duskend Purges
entities.description: Purges during which Ludmilla was killed.

events.summary: The Sisters overthrow their master Svogthir, imprison him and seal his remains in the Undercity, at the cost of two of their number.
events.quote: They turned against their master and overthrew him, at the cost of the lives of two of them.

events.summary: Savra, with Szadek, finds Svogthir and gives him a new body; he kills two Sisters, leaving Ludmilla.
events.quote: swiftly killed two of them, making Ludmilla the last living sister

events.summary: Ludmilla leads the Golgari attack on Centerfort and is spared by Feather on condition of never showing her face on the surface.
events.quote: Ludmilla later led the Golgari attack on Centerfort during the Decamillennial.

events.summary: The Azorius capture Ludmilla and teenage Vraska; Ludmilla is blinded and killed in the Duskend Purges.
events.quote: Ludmilla was blinded and killed during the Duskend Purges, starting Vraska on her path of vengeance.

relations.quote: They turned against their master and overthrew him
